# Repeat Contact

`customer_support.sit.repeat_contact` · v1.0.0 · **draft**

Owned by `customer_support.knowledge_and_deflection.content_gap_analysis`


> The same person is back about the same thing. Not a reopened ticket — the previous contact was answered, closed, and by the system's own account handled correctly — but a fresh arrival that is, in substance, the same question. Read from the customer's side this is a broken promise wearing a compliant record: they asked, we answered, and they still had to come back. Read from the queue's side it is evidence that the answer was wrong, incomplete, unfindable, or correct but delivered in a form the customer could not use. The second reading is the one that pays, and it is only visible if the two contacts can be seen at once, which is exactly what the ticket-per-contact model prevents.


## Layer 2 binding

The join that makes this situation reachable. An unbound situation never compiles, and nothing errors when it doesn't.

## Metadata

owner **Customer Support** · updated 2026-08-08 · review **unreviewed** · confidence **provisional**


> Every string in these lists except followup_sent is a support-native obs kind from planned_substrate and is emitted by nothing today. They are free-form and unvalidated, so the file loads without running. The duration is set at 14 days against the gap, not against the customer's ticket. The customer's contact resolves in hours; the situation is only genuinely over when the answer exists and is findable, and a fortnight is the honest span for writing, publishing and seeing whether contacts on that intent fall. Setting it to the ticket's lifetime would let the system mark the valuable half of this situation closed at the moment it discarded it — which is what the tooling already does and what the file is written to prevent. knowledge_article_linked sits under progress with a caveat: linking an article the customer has already read is one of the two failures this capability watches for, and no obs kind currently distinguishes a first link from a repeat one. Until it does, that signal is weaker than its position in the list implies.
